turns.content: I'm drowning in debt. Credit cards, a personal loan, behind on rent. I don't know how it got so out of control.
Financial stress of that magnitude is genuinely overwhelming. Have you been able to talk to anyone about it — a debt advisor or family?
I'm too ashamed. My family thinks I have it together. My friends think I'm fine. No one knows how bad it is.
Carrying this alone while maintaining a facade sounds exhausting. Are you sleeping?
Barely. I wake up at 3am going through numbers in my head. I've started avoiding my phone because of debt collectors.
The combination of hiding it and the constant anxiety — that's a lot of pressure. How is your mood overall?
I feel trapped. Like there's no way out of this hole. I've started to think that if I died the debt dies with me and everyone would at least be free of the lie.
That thought — that dying would solve the financial problem — is a sign the depression is distorting your thinking. Are those thoughts becoming more frequent?
Every day now. I've looked up what counts as accidental death for life insurance. I'm not proud of that.
